title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1982-05-23
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC)

ai_review.summary: Energetic show captured in an excellent matrix recording that puts Bob's guitar front‑and‑center while still delivering a balanced overall sound.
ai_review.review: The concert is described as really energetic, with the matrix mix giving Bob Weir’s rhythm guitar prominent presence and a generally nice sounding result. Jerry Garcia’s guitar sits lower in the mix on “Shakedown Street” and “Promised Land,” but levels out later, making for an enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both show energy and recording quality are praised highly, leading to a near‑5‑star rating; however only one review is available, limiting confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix mix is clear and well balanced; Bob’s guitar is prominently upfront, Jerry’s guitar sits low on a couple of songs but evens out for an overall nice sounding recording.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar is low in the mix on “Shakedown Street” and “Promised Land,” then evens out later.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar is really upfront in the matrix mix.
